==Bundles==
Summer Squash may be chosen as one of the options for the {{Bundle|Summer Crops remixed||y}}.

==Recipes==
Summer Squash is not used in any recipes.

==Tailoring==
Summer Squash can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] with [[Cloth]] in the feed to create the dyeable [[Tailoring#Shirts|Tank Top]].
*Male Version: [[File:Shirt129.png|24px|link=]]
*Female Version: [[File:Shirt130.png|24px|link=]]

It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a yellow dye at the dye pots located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. It can also be used as a yellow dye when used in the spool of the [[Sewing Machine]] with a dyeable clothing item in the feed.

==Quests==
Summer Squash is not used in any [[quests]].
